N'elu ala dị larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, ike kwụ ọtọ $F = 10\text{ N}$ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe dị arọ $m = 2\text{ kg}$ n'ebe dị anya nke $4\text{ m}$. Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọrụ $W$ na ngwangwa $a$ n'ụzọ ziri ezi?
20261118-physics-g01.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Fiziks] Nsogbu na-etinye ụkpụrụ nke Magnet na ihe. N'elu ala dị larịị na-enweghị esemokwu, ike kwụ ọtọ $F = 10\text{ N}$ na-arụ ọrụ n'ihe dị arọ $m = 2\text{ kg}$ n'ebe dị anya nke $4\text{ m}$. Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọrụ $W$ na ngwangwa $a$ n'ụzọ ziri ezi?
20261118-physics-g01.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Site n'iwu nke abụọ nke Newton $F = ma$, ngwangwa $a = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{10\text{ N}}{2\text{ kg}} = 5\text{ m/s}^2$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Ọrụ a rụrụ bụ $W = F \cdot s = 10\text{ N} \times 4\text{ m} = 40\text{ J}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ya mere ngwangwa bụ $5\text{ m/s}^2$ na ọrụ bụ $40\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-g01-1.title: Magnet na ihe
20261121-physics-g01-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Magnet na ihe iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261121-physics-g01-1.material: [E1 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Magnet na ihe. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g01-1.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Magnet na ihe. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g01-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọsọ $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Anya $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ya mere $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ na $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.

Nkwupụta dị aṅaa na-akọwa ọrụ $W$ na ngwangwa $a$ n'ụzọ ziri ezi?

20261121-physics-g02-1.title: Ụda na mkpọtụ
20261121-physics-g02-1.goal: Tinye ụkpụrụ nke Ụda na mkpọtụ iji dozie nsogbu nnyocha.
20261121-physics-g02-1.material: [E2 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Ụda na mkpọtụ. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g02-1.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Nnyocha Fiziks (Dị Elu)] Nyocha mmegharị ọdịda n'efu metụtara Ụda na mkpọtụ. A tụpụrụ otu ihe site na izu ike na mbara na-enweghị ikuku n'okpuru ike ndọda $g = 9.8\text{ m/s}^2$. Gịnị bụ ọsọ $v$ na anya $h$ mgbe $t = 3\text{ s}$ gachara?
20261121-physics-g02-1.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Ọsọ $v = gt = 9.8 \times 3 = 29.4\text{ m/s}$.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Anya $h = \frac{1}{2}gt^2 = 0.5 \times 9.8 \times 9 = 44.1\text{ m}$.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Ya mere $v = 29.4\text{ m/s}$ na $h = 44.1\text{ m}$.
